messages:
maria: Quick question — if we unpin the default model in the upcoming change, what's the exact API fallback/resolution behavior? Need to update client SDK notes. cc @alex @cheng

alex: Short answer: we respect any explicit model/version header. If none, we try app-level pin, then account default, then global default. If a requested pinned version is gone, what do we return?

cheng: Server routing priority is: 1) X-Redwood-Model header, 2) client config pin, 3) account pin, 4) org default, 5) global default. If the header or pin references a removed model we return 412 (Precondition Failed) unless allow_fallback=true, in which case we route to the best compatible variant and add warn header. Also we emit model_routing_error metric.

alex: To be explicit: when allow_fallback=true we return 200 with X-Redwood-Fallback: true and X-Redwood-Original-Model set. When allow_fallback is absent or false we return 412 and a small JSON error payload. :ok_hand:

maria: Can you paste the exact header/query param names so I can update the SDK docs?

cheng: Sure:
```
# header
X-Redwood-Model: rwd/gpt-4o-8k@v2
# query param
?allow_fallback=true
```
We also add X-Redwood-Warn: model-fallback in responses when fallback happened.

sam: Note for SDK: we'll keep client default pinning behavior but add a deprecation warning when global default is unpinned. Plan is 6wks notice + toggle in console. @alex FYI for email.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: rollout/default-unpin-v2 -> canary 10% at 1987654360 :rocket:

jamal: I'm on-call that window. What should I watch for? Specific alerts?

cheng: Alert rules: model_routing_errors rate > 0.1% above baseline for 5m, and 5xx increase on inference endpoints > 0.5%.

maria: Great, thanks. Action items: @alex draft deprecation email, @sam update SDK defaulting & add deprecation note, @cheng add tests + metric alert, @jamal monitor canary. I'll PR docs tonight. :thumbsup:
